bio: A colourful restaurant with a winning culinary concept: intensely flavoursome Asian cuisine with a French twist. The extensive menu features a tempting array of dishes that are also perfect for sharing. Exquisite sea bass ceviche, crispy duck with an orange cream, vegetarian gyoza with a kimchi and chilli mayonnaise sauce… deciding what to order will not be easy! With plenty of wonderful vegetarian options and its €25 lunch deal, this place is a real asset to Rotterdam's dining scene....
